item.title: Crochet Knit-style Ribbing - Version 1
item.description: Looks like knit, but it’s crochet! It’s also very stretchy and a simple ribbing pattern! It’s simply a two row repeat of Yarn-over slip stitches, and slip stitches in the back loops. This can be made any length. Start with any number of chs. Ch1 does not count as st. ROW 1: Starting in 2nd ch from hook YoSlst in each ch. ROW 2: Ch1, turn, Slst in the back loops only of each st. ROW 3: Ch1, turn, YoSlst in each st. Repeat alternating ROWS 2 & 3 until desired length
